actions.rationale: Sidecar open_positions is empty, so OPEN rather than ADD. Long duration on the locked 2027 CRA strip expresses underpriced Canadian easing versus a 2.29 CORRA benchmark and 38 labor score. $85m of the $100m gross cap leaves $15m unused against energy-pass-through risk while still paying the 3.85% SOFR vig on the full allocation.

events.invalidation: BoC delivers or signals the priced 2027 mid-3s path, or trim/median leave ~2% while jobs stop contracting.
events.rationale: FACT: overnight CORRA is 2.29 and the 2027 3m strip implies 3.13-3.595 while 1m CORRA is only 2.58 by December; August employment was -42k, wages +2.0% y/y, CPI-trim/median 1.9%/2.0%. INFERENCE: 2027 CRA is pricing an energy-pass-through hiking cycle that domestic labor and core do not require, so receiving that window is the underpriced-easing trade. Expression is rates-first; spot USDCAD long is the alternative and is inferior because oil and CAD-short covering can hold CAD up even if CRA 2027 reprices lower.

events.invalidation: BoC delivers or signals the priced 2027 mid-3s path, or core/trim leave ~2 percent while jobs stop contracting.
events.rationale: FACT: Canada is pricing a 2027 hike cycle (CORRA 2.29 to 2027H-Z 3.40, +111bp) while August core/trim-median sit at 1.9-2.0 percent, employment contracted 42k, and wages slowed to 2.0 percent. INFERENCE: hawks are treating energy pass-through and Fed/BoJ tightening as sufficient to re-tighten Canada into the mid-3s; labor and underlying CPI say that cycle will not be delivered, so 2027 implied CORRA falls. UNKNOWN: whether a renewed oil spike or a strong Q3 GDP follow-through on the +0.8 percent Q2 print can keep the BoC on a hiking path despite jobs. Actionable expression: stay long the existing 2027H-Z strip.
